summary: This is a narrowly-scoped, correct bug fix to construction-boq-import-service.ts's Excel BoQ header-mapping and row-parsing logic, addressing a real defect where mapBoqHeaders() picked the first header in sheet order matching ANY alias (so a generic 'Category' column won over the real 'Description (Task)' column) and 'Sl No' was never recognized as an itemCode alias at all, causing all real task/sub-task rows to be dropped on the real prospect file shape. The fix changes header resolution to try each field's aliases in priority order (so a dedicated description column always beats the 'category' fallback), adds 'sl no' as an itemCode alias, adds a new subTask field with its own aliases, and adds positional parent-child inference for unlabeled sub-task rows (attaching them to the nearest preceding row's itemCode when they carry no itemCode of their own but do have a breakdownPercentage). I traced the algorithm by hand against the new xlsx-based regression test fixture (category header rows, multi-line descriptions with embedded 'Location :' text, unlabeled Frame/Gypsum Board/etc. sub-task rows under two different parent tasks) and confirmed the code produces exactly the asserted output, including correctly resetting the positional-inference anchor at each new task row so sub-tasks never bleed across parents. The change does not touch computeHierarchicalAmount() or any calculation/schema/migration/auth code, matches the diff's own stated constraints, and the PROGRESS.md/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml changes are routine documentation and claim-registration housekeeping. No .github/workflows files are touched.
